verdict.rationale: Fellow can be automated headlessly through its Developer API. Requests authenticate with non-interactive API keys, and the API supports reading recordings and action items, writing note agendas, uploading recordings with status polling, and paginated listing. Webhooks push event notifications, so an unattended script or CI job can drive the product without the UI. missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK, CI-specific guidance or examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
